catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class fits one raw Float64MultiArray publication of three joint efforts on /forward_effort_controller/commands. cap.motion.joint_torque.v1 is an experimental invoke class that expects a joint-torque command with an acknowledged application result and a stop path; a rosbridge publication has no controller acknowledgement, and the joint order mixes revolute N*m and prismatic N efforts. The package uses an x-cap with an inline three-element array schema. The output is published, confirmed (always false) and sent_efforts, the three values handed to rosbridge, not a measurement and not a stop. The stop is the companion gazebo_ros world pause.

No catalogue class carries a passive sensor_msgs/JointState sample. cap.motion.joint_position.v1 is an invoke class that commands joint positions and requires an acknowledged motion result; it does not observe names, positions, velocities and a header stamp. The main resource reads no topic: which node publishes /joint_states while the world is paused is not settled by the source (rrbot_world.launch.py:69-75 starts a standalone ros2_control_node).

No catalogue class observes a std_msgs/String that carries a four-line homogeneous transform. The catalogue has pose and motion command classes but no forward-kinematics observation class with a text matrix output.

No catalogue class computes an end-effector velocity from a joint-velocity request. cap.motion.cartesian_twist.v1 commands a Cartesian twist and returns applied/stopped; the pinned Fvel callback is an observational Jacobian product that commands no motion and returns endeff_vel_x, endeff_vel_y and endeff_vel_z.
